origin.body: Our Robusta grows in Desa Pujungan, Kecamatan Pupuan, Tabanan — a quiet mountain village of cool mist and forest shade. Our Arabica is picked on the slopes of Kintamani, Bangli, a name already known well beyond Indonesia. Two terroirs, one standard: only hand-picked, fully ripe Grade 1 cherries.
roasting.heading: Slowly roasted to perfection.
roasting.spec.roastType.label: Roast Level
roasting.spec.process.label: Process
roasting.spec.freshness.label: Freshness
roasting.body: Every batch is roasted to the same exacting standard, so each bag delivers the identical quality and character — the cup you would expect from the finest café.
product.arabica.name: Arabica Kintamani
product.arabica.label: Specialty · Grade 1
product.arabica.description: Picked from fully ripe, hand-selected cherries and semi-washed — yielding a clean, complex cup with floral aromatics, a soft citrus lift, natural sweetness and rich chocolate.
product.arabica.bestFor: V60 · Pour Over · Espresso · Latte · Cappuccino
product.robusta.name: Fine Robusta Pupuan
product.robusta.label: Fine Robusta · Grade 1
product.robusta.description: From the finest estates in Pupuan — dense chocolate aromatics, roasted nuts and a touch of caramel. A thick body and powerful flavour that still lands smooth on the palate.
product.robusta.bestFor: Espresso · Americano · Kopi Tubruk · French Press · Milk Coffee
product.blend.name: House Blend Special
product.blend.label: Signature Blend
product.blend.description: An exclusive marriage of both our Grade 1 beans — strong body, fragrant aroma, rich chocolate, a hint of natural sweetness and a creamy texture that is hard to forget.
product.blend.customText: Choose your own ratio — anywhere from 50:50 to 75:25 Arabica.
